hero.label: Railway station operation analysis
hero.title: Station capacity
hero.description: The module supports railway station teaching and scheme analysis. Based on station topology, route occupancy and train operation plans, it provides process modeling, constraint solving, bottleneck identification, capacity estimation, and 2D and 3D plan playback.
hero.mediaCaption: Screenshot · Route generation, path highlighting and property configuration

features.title: Module functions and scope of analysis
features.description: Modeling, planning, model solving and result analysis are organized around station geometry, operation timing and resource occupancy relationships.

layout.title: Station modeling
layout.description: DWG import and manual drawing support the definition of station geometry, node and track topology, switches, signals and track circuit sections.

routes.title: Routes & occupancy
routes.description: Route search and batch generation support the definition of routes and directly conflicting sections. Section occupancy offsets are specified relative to operation times.

planning.title: Processes & plans
planning.description: Activities, events and precedence constraints describe operation processes. The module supports template reuse within schemes, batch plan generation and CSV occupancy imports.

solving.title: Model solving
solving.description: A solver agent handles duration, event precedence and mutually exclusive section occupancy constraints. Solver presets and saving feasible solutions as plans are supported.

analysis.title: Bottlenecks & capacity
analysis.description: Operation plans and section occupancy parameters provide the basis for occupancy statistics, bottleneck utilization, capacity estimates and summaries by route category.

playback.title: 2D & 3D playback
playback.description: Existing plans can be replayed for individual trains or the entire station. Arrivals, dwelling and departures are displayed to support review of operation timing and spatial relationships.

workflow.title: Modeling and analysis workflow
workflow.description: Data are organized by calculation instance, station scheme and operation plan. Process and train templates are shared within a scheme; solving, analysis and playback apply to the selected plan.

steps.title: Station modeling
steps.description: A station scheme defines geometry, topology and equipment properties within a calculation instance.

steps.title: Operation planning
steps.description: Routes, section occupancy parameters and process templates form the basis for generating or importing train plans.

steps.title: Constraint solving
steps.description: An available agent solves existing train operations using a solver preset. Validated feasible solutions are saved as saturated plans.

steps.title: Analysis and playback
steps.description: Occupancy and bottleneck utilization are calculated, capacity estimates are summarized, and plans are reviewed through 2D or 3D playback.

showcase.title: Main functions and data relationships
showcase.description: Station schemes and operation plans link the representation of spatial structure, operation constraints, section occupancy and train movements.

layout.title: Station topology and route modeling
layout.description: Nodes and tracks describe station topology and are associated with equipment, track circuit sections and routes. These data support resource configuration and section occupancy analysis.

planning.title: Process modeling and plan generation
planning.description: Activities and events represent operation processes, with duration ranges, precedence and alternative resources specified as constraints. Process templates are instantiated as train operation plans.

analysis.title: Section occupancy and capacity analysis
analysis.description: Operation times and section occupancy offsets determine occupancy intervals. Route operation counts and bottleneck utilization support capacity estimates for a specified observation period and allowance coefficient.
points: Operation occupancy displayed by time and track circuit section
Route operation counts, occupancy time and utilization statistics

playback.title: 2D and 3D operation plan playback
playback.description: Existing operation plans and station paths determine the display of train movements, dwelling and route occupancy in 2D and 3D views, supporting review of operation timing and spatial relationships.

roadmap.title: Development phases and objectives
roadmap.description: Development is organized into three phases: user interaction and visualization, solver integration, and simulation engine development. The long-term plan covers unified interfaces and adaptation to different railway systems.
roadmap.preview: The Phase 1 Preview is expected to be available around the end of 2026.

phases.label: Phase 1
phases.title: User interaction and visualization
phases.description: An interactive station operation environment based on manual modeling and operation planning.
points: Graphical station layout drawing
Manual train operation planning
2D and 3D visualization

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.title: Solvers and automatic plan generation
phases.description: Integration of algorithms for station operation planning and capacity calculation to generate operation plans automatically.
points: Station operation planning solver integration
Station capacity calculation solver integration
Automatic operation plan generation

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.title: Traction calculation and simulation engine
phases.description: Integration of train traction calculation, signaling and related functions to form a station operation simulation engine.
points: Train traction calculation integration
Signaling function integration
Station operation simulation engine development

outlook.label: LONG-TERM PLAN
outlook.title: Unified interfaces and system compatibility
outlook.description: Unified interfaces are planned to accommodate different rolling stock types, train control methods and signaling systems.

cta.title: Application conditions and data requirements
cta.description: Capacity analysis requires station topology, route definitions, section occupancy parameters and train operation plans. Comparisons between schemes or plans require a consistent observation period and allowance coefficient.
cta.note: Model solving is performed through CapacityAgent. Saturated plan solving applies to existing trains and operations. Capacity estimates depend on plan data, occupancy parameters and statistical settings.
